```artifact
Feature: Admin functionality for managing Specialities and Doctors
  Background: Admin can add, update, and manage Specialities and their associated Doctors

  Scenario: Add a new unique Speciality
    Given the Admin is logged in
    When the Admin enters a new Speciality title and submits the form
    Then the system confirms the addition and displays the Speciality details
    Examples:
      | title                | expectation                                  |
      | Cardiology           | The system confirms the addition and displays the Speciality details |

  Scenario: Update details of an existing Speciality
    Given the Admin is logged in
    And an existing Speciality with specific details is already in the system
    When the Admin updates the details and submits the form
    Then the system reflects the updated details and confirms the changes
    Examples:
      | title                | updated details                          | expectation                                  |
      | Cardiology           | Updated cardiology details             | The system reflects the updated details and confirms the changes |

  Scenario: Delete a Speciality with no associated Doctors
    Given the Admin is logged in
    And a Speciality with no associated Doctors is selected for deletion
    When the Admin deletes the Speciality
    Then the Speciality is removed and a confirmation message is displayed
    Examples:
      | title                | expectation                                  |
      | Cardiology           | The Speciality is removed and a confirmation message is displayed |

  Scenario: Associate a Doctor with an existing Speciality
    Given the Admin is logged in
    And an existing Speciality exists with associated Doctors
    When the Admin associates a Doctor with the Speciality
    Then the Doctor appears under the Speciality
    Examples:
      | title                | Doctor details                          | expectation                                  |
      | Cardiology           | Cardiologist details                | The Doctor appears under the Speciality |

  Scenario: Remove a Doctor from an existing Speciality
    Given the Admin is logged in
    And a Doctor with specific details is associated with a Speciality
    When the Admin removes the Doctor
    Then the Doctor is removed and a confirmation message is displayed
    Examples:
      | title                | Doctor details                          | expectation                                  |
      | Cardiology           | Cardiologist details                | The Doctor is removed and a confirmation message is displayed |

  Scenario: Add a new Speciality with no associated Doctors
    Given the Admin is logged in
    When the Admin enters a new Speciality title without associating a Doctor
    And the Speciality does not have any associated Doctors
    When the Admin submits the form
    Then the Speciality is added and a prompt for Doctor association appears
    Examples:
      | title                | expectation                                  |
      | Cardiology           | The Speciality is added and a prompt for Doctor association appears |

  Scenario: Update an existing Speciality with associated Doctors
    Given the Admin is logged in
    And a Speciality exists with associated Doctors
    When the Admin updates the details of the Speciality
    And the updated details are valid
    Then the Speciality reflects the updated details and confirms the changes
    Examples:
      | title                | updated details                          | expectation                                  |
      | Cardiology           | Updated cardiology details             | The Speciality reflects the updated details and confirms the changes |

  Scenario: Add a new Speciality type that is nearly identical to existing ones
    Given the Admin is logged in
    And a Speciality type that is nearly identical to existing ones is available for addition
    When the Admin enters the nearly identical Speciality title
    And the system prompts for clarification
    Then the system prevents duplicate entries
    Examples:
      | title                | expectation                                  |
      | "Cardiology 2.0"       | The system prompts for clarification and prevents duplicate entries |

  Scenario: Add a Speciality type that is not allowed (e.g., numeric or empty string)
    Given the Admin is logged in
    And a Speciality type that is not allowed (e.g., numeric or empty string) is available for addition
    When the Admin enters the disallowed Speciality title
    Then the system rejects the entry and prompts for a valid name
    Examples:
      | title                | expectation                                  |
      | "2" or ""            | The system rejects the entry and prompts for a valid name |

  Scenario: Add a Speciality type that is at the boundary of allowed naming conventions
    Given the Admin is logged in
    And a Speciality type that is at the boundary of allowed naming conventions is available for addition
    When the Admin enters the boundary Speciality title
    Then the system accepts the entry but may require additional confirmation
    Examples:
      | title                | expectation                                  |
      | "Cardio-" or "Cardio-2" | The system accepts the entry but may require additional confirmation |

  Scenario: Add multiple Specialities with Doctors at the edge of their associations
    Given the Admin is logged in
    And multiple Specialities with Doctors at the edge of their associations exist
    When the Admin enters new Speciality titles
    And the Admin submits the forms
    Then all Doctors are associated with the new Speciality without errors
    Examples:
      | title                | expectation                                  |
      | Cardiology, Neurology | All Doctors are associated with the new Speciality without errors |

  Scenario: Add a new Speciality type that is nearly identical to existing ones with associated Doctors
    Given the Admin is logged in
    And multiple Specialities with associated Doctors exist
    When the Admin enters nearly identical Speciality titles
    And the Admin submits the forms
    Then the system prevents duplicate entries and maintains Doctor associations
    Examples:
      | title                | expectation                                  |
      | "Cardiology 2.0", "Neurology 2.0" | The system prevents duplicate entries and maintains Doctor associations |

Note: The above scenarios assume that the system uses arrays or lists to represent collections of Specialities and Doctors, as indicated by the requirement to test array types for these operations. The actual implementation may differ, and the test cases should be adjusted accordingly.
